findings.evidence: `Deck/FundamentalGroup/UniversalCover.lean:52-93` independently builds `loopDeck` and `loopDeckHom`; `rg` finds no consumer of `loopDeckHom` outside that defining block, while `Action.lean:154-159` provides the required quotient-covering map.
findings.fix: Refactor `loopDeck`, `loopDeckHom`, and their elementary laws to aliases/specializations of `IsQuotientCoveringMap.toDeckHom (UniversalCover.isQuotientCoveringMap x₀)`; retain compatibility names if needed.
findings.issue: `toDeckHom` duplicates the existing universal-cover specialization `UniversalCover.loopDeckHom`, including separately proved one/multiplication laws.

findings.evidence: `Deck/FundamentalGroup/UniversalCover.lean:110-118` manually uses `proj_eq_iff_mem_orbit` and `loopDeck`; `Action.lean:154-159` already packages that action as an `IsQuotientCoveringMap`, exactly the input of the new theorem.
findings.fix: Keep `isRegular_proj` as the public specialization, but prove it directly with `IsQuotientCoveringMap.isRegular (UniversalCover.isQuotientCoveringMap x₀)`.
findings.issue: The generalized `IsQuotientCoveringMap.isRegular` makes the existing proof of `UniversalCover.isRegular_proj` an unnecessary rederivation of regularity from orbit transitivity.

summary: The generic acting-group API leaves existing universal-cover code as a parallel hand-built specialization instead of reusing it.
